subject: Concurrent Tracks: Sprint Schedule & Debrief Windows for Virtual Onsite
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Klein <sarah.klein@acmeproducts.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed format: Concurrent tracks for virtual onsite (candidate: Jordan Doe)

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for coordinating Jordan's loop. Based on previous conversation, we'd like to run a condensed virtual onsite with two concurrent tracks to keep the overall candidate day to ~3.5 hours (plus breaks). High-level proposal below — can you confirm Jordan's timezone preferences and whether any sessions need to be morning-only?

Proposed day (PT):
- 09:30 - 10:15 Track A (Product + PM) — Panel A (3 interviewers)
- 09:30 - 10:15 Track B (Infra + Systems) — Panel B (3 interviewers)
- 10:25 - 11:10 Cross-functional design exercise (interviewer pair rotates in)
- 11:10 - 11:30 Break / Candidate buffer
- 11:30 - 12:00 Deep-dive with hiring manager (1:1)
- 12:05 - 12:50 Debrief window A/B (parallel) — 45 minutes per track to capture notes and calibrate

Notes / asks:
- We plan to assign a floater for each track to handle candidate questions / follow-ups if an interviewer needs to drop.
- Attached is Jordan's resume and a raw panel matrix; I'll iterate with the team once we have confirmed roles.
- If Jordan prefers earlier in the day (before 09:00 PT) please flag — we can compress slots.

Can you confirm availability for any day next week (May 24–28)? If you prefer, provide 2 windows and we will align interviewers.

Thanks,
Connor
Connor O'Brien
Recruiting Operations | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com
--

From: Sarah Klein <sarah.klein@acmeproducts.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Recruiting <recruiters@acmeproducts.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Proposed format: Concurrent tracks for virtual onsite (candidate: Jordan Doe)

Connor —

Thanks, this looks good. Jordan prefers mornings PT (ideally starting between 08:00–09:30 PT). He is available Thu May 27 or Fri May 28. He prefers no more than two back-to-back technical sessions without a short break.

A couple quick clarifications:
- The cross-functional design exercise — will that be timed and proctored? If possible, Jordan would like a short brief a day prior.
- Can you confirm whether interviews will be recorded? Acme policy requires candidate consent.

I can lock in May 27 morning if those times work on your side; recruiters will send calendar holds once you confirm.

Best,
Sarah Klein
Senior Talent Partner, Acme Products

Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Concurrent-track plan + panel matrix (need leads + floaters)

Connor / team —

I can lead Panel A. Quick tweaks:
- Make Panel A interviewer order: PM -> Product -> Cross-functional engineer. That order helps with the narrative for product sense.
- Prefer a 30-min buffer between design exercise and HM 1:1; can we slide HM to 10:40 and shorten debrief windows to 40 mins each? That keeps total day under 4 hours and gives space to sync.

Also attaching a debrief_template.docx I use — two short sections (strengths, risks) per interviewer makes consensus faster. Please populate with notes ASAP after interviews so we can close within 48 hours.

Mina — if you take Panel B lead we will need one senior engineer as floater; I can ask Karthik if available.

Laura Bennett
Director, Product Recruiting | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

- 08:30–09:10 Track B (Infra + Systems) — Panel B (lead: Mina Haddad)

Action items (quick):

Thanks everyone — excited to run a tight, candidate-friendly day.
